[The Spatial Analysis for Biological Imaging workshop.](https://www.quantitativebioimaging.com/qbi2023/sabi2023/)

We present new results from the analysis of the spatial distribution of T-cells
in colorectal cancer. These results were obtained in the framework of the
AZV-funded [project](../projects.qmd).
